extensionDescription.message: Breathy is your companion that guides breathing on Spanish casino websites for self-care and responsible gaming

tutorialStep1Content.message: Your digital companion for responsible gaming. I help you maintain control while browsing.

tutorialStep2Content.message: This is Breathy, your digital mascot. His emotions reflect your gaming state: happy when all is well, tired when you need a break, and angry when risk is detected.

tutorialStep3Content.message: Automatically detects betting sites and online casinos. No setup needed, it works immediately.

tutorialStep4Content.message: When Breathy detects stress or long sessions, it guides you through breathing exercises to stay calm.

tutorialStep5Content.message: Set time and money limits. Breathy will gently remind you when approaching these limits.

tutorialStep6Content.message: Click the Breathy icon in the toolbar to access settings and statistics.

tutorialStep7Content.message: All your data is stored locally in your browser. Breathy doesn't send information to external servers.

tutorialStep8Content.message: You now know the basics. Breathy will be here to support you on your journey to more conscious and responsible gaming.

customSitesDescription.message: Register sites where you want Breathy to activate

testModeDescription.message: Speed up time: 1 second = 1 real minute

continuousBreathingDescription.message: Keeps the breathing rhythm always active

dragonMessageHappy.message: Enjoy responsibly, I'm here to accompany you

dragonMessageTired.message: You've reached half your time. Don't you think we deserve a break?

dragonMessageAngry.message: Time's up! You set this limit. Stay true to your decision

breathingInstructions.message: Follow the circle with your breathing

realityCheck1.message: How are you feeling so far? Remember you can take a break

realityCheck2.message: Are you playing with money you can afford to lose?

realityCheck3.message: Take a moment to do some deep breathing

realityCheck4.message: Games are designed to make you feel like you're close to winning. Don't fall for the trap

realityCheck5.message: Remember: gambling should be fun, not a way to make money

realityCheck6.message: How long have you been playing? Time flies

realityCheck7.message: Ask yourself: do I need this money for something important?

realityCheck8.message: Do you feel in control of your gambling decisions?

realityCheck9.message: Did you have something to do later? Don't lose track of time

realityCheck10.message: Before continuing to play, make sure you've set a loss limit

realityCheck11.message: Remember: there's no strategy that guarantees winning, it's all luck

realityCheck12.message: If you're gambling to feel better, it's the worst time to gamble

realityCheck13.message: If any result made you feel bad today, it's a sign to stop

realityCheck14.message: Trying to recover losses is one of the main causes of big losses

realityCheck15.message: Gambling should never interfere with your responsibilities

prepareToBreath.message: Get ready to breathe with me

reflectionPrompt.message:
Now that you've stopped to breathe,
think calmly...
Do you really want to keep gambling?

continueGambling.message: Thanks, but I want to continue

wellDoneBreakTime.message: Well done! It's time to take a break 👋

closeTabSuggestion.message: Close this tab and take a break.

wellbeingImportant.message: Your wellbeing is what matters most.
